deliverables: Frontend maintenance and cross-platform development for Chrome extension, web/PWA, iOS, Android, beta channel, CIPs, hardfork features, multisig, dApp interoperability, app store compliance, and hardware wallet support

Backend infrastructure and operations including multi-region servers, Cardano nodes, DBSync indexers, application servers, metadata aggregation, Hub backend services, monitoring, alerting, and incident response
Governance tooling enhancements including DRep dashboards, proposal browsers, in-wallet voting, and proposal creation tooling
User support through Discord ticketing, Telegram, public channels, ecosystem project support, wiki maintenance, and educational videos
Day-to-day operations including release management, hardware wallet vendor coordination, dApp/CIP coordination, code review, and security practices
Periodic independent audits of treasury fund use and implementation of oversight metrics
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund 12 months of Eternl operations, maintenance, and improvements, including frontend and backend work, infrastructure, user support, administration, and audits/oversight.

claims.claim: Eternl is a non-custodial Cardano light wallet for web, browser extension, Android, and iOS used for payments, staking, governance, and DApp interaction.
The proposal requests ₳2,350,000, valued at about $0.1787 per Ada, to cover approximately $420,000 in annual costs for 12 months.
The requested budget is allocated as 55% frontend, 25% backend, 5% support, 13% admin, and 2% audits.
The proposal funds 6.0 FTE across 10 contributors at $70,000 per FTE.

Eternl plans to introduce Pro plans priced at $96/year for personal users and $360/year for company users, and asserts that roughly 5,500 users, about 4.2% of its install base, would fully cover the $420,000 annual cost.
Eternl states it has about 100,000 browser-extension installs and about 30,000 Android/iOS installs.

After withdrawal, the proposer says it will convert up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins, place it in a public company wallet, return any Ada above that amount to the treasury, and keep unconverted Ada undelegated to SPOs and delegated to abstain voting.

The audits allocation is for independent audits of treasury fund use in February 2027 and August 2027, covering receipt, custody, conversion, spending, balances, Pro plan income relevant to repayment, refunds, repayments, and oversight metrics such as balances, conversion rates, transaction hashes, and repayment hashes.

The proposer commits to semiannual repayment checks and says surplus stablecoins plus paid plan income above $420,000 will be used to repay the treasury until $420,000 in Ada value is repaid, followed by possible additional donations capped at $210,000 worth of Ada.
Eternl asserts that 10-18% of Cardano mainnet transactions are conducted via Eternl and that Eternl has provided multi-platform access with basically zero downtime for over five years.

summary: The document asks for ₳2,350,000 for 12 months of Eternl operations from August 2026 through July 2027, with a stated path toward Pro-plan sustainability, treasury repayment mechanics, and fund-use audit commitments, but many adoption and impact claims are asserted without direct evidence in the anchor text.
